proposed.text: A waiting area meets chair-width requirements but forces strangers to sit shoulder-to-shoulder. Which concept best explains the remaining problem?

options.text: Color temperature, because seating distance is only a hue problem.
The ken, because all seats must follow a Japanese bay module.
Structural rhythm, because the problem is only column spacing.
Proxemics, because comfortable interpersonal distance is separate from body fit.

rationale.correct: TOA 3 defines proxemics through spatial separation in social and interpersonal situations.
rationale.takeaway: A plan can fit bodies but still fail proxemic comfort.
rationale.a: Color vocabulary does not explain interpersonal spacing.
rationale.b: A specific module is not the issue here.
rationale.c: Column rhythm does not by itself resolve personal-space comfort.

proposed.explanation: TOA 3 defines proxemics through spatial separation in social and interpersonal situations. A plan can fit bodies but still fail proxemic comfort.
